    Prepare and Validate FFEM Data Against a Model's $INPUT Record

    prepareAndValidateData.Rd

    Reads an FFEM dataset and a NONMEM model file, and aligns the dataset's column names with those specified in the model's $INPUT record. It validates that the column count matches and that all specified covariates are present in the $INPUT record. This function is robust to multi-line, abbreviated, and commented $INPUT records.

    Usage

    prepareAndValidateData(
  ffemDataFile,
  baseModelFile,
  covariates,
  quiet = FALSE,
  keepDoseOnlySubjects = FALSE,
  strID = "ID"
)

    Arguments

    ffemDataFile

    A character string path to the FFEM dataset, or a data.frame.

    baseModelFile

    A character string path to the base NONMEM model file.

    covariates

    A character vector of covariate names (must match the names in the $INPUT record) that the user intends to model.

    quiet

    Logical. Should the function execute silently? Defaults to FALSE.

    keepDoseOnlySubjects

    Logical. If FALSE (default), subjects without any valid PK observations (e.g., only dosing records) are completely excluded from the generated dataset. If TRUE, these subjects are retained and their covariates are included as observations.

    strID

    Character. The name of the subject identifier column. Defaults to "ID".

    Value

    A list containing three elements:

    validatedData

    The data frame with column names replaced by the parsed $INPUT names.

    originalNames

    The original data header names from the data file.

    inputNames

    The clean character vector of names parsed from the $INPUT record.
